barTime.rule: daily mid bars that open at 17:00 America/New_York; the trading date is the open date plus one day; a bar whose trading date is a Saturday or Sunday is a weekend stub and is dropped; a bar with complete false is the forming bar and is never evaluated
barTime.label: measured

prices.rule: OANDA mid OHLC from the FXEmpire proxy, price=M, count=250
prices.label: measured

spreadBps.label: assumed
spreadBps.source: 2 bps per side, as swing44 used, https://github.com/mfittko/market-signals/issues/310#issuecomment-6082874730; subtracted from the log return

rollover.rule: one night at each 17:00 America/New_York instant the trade holds across, counted by rollovers() in platform/internal/research/e0.go, so a Friday to Monday hold counts 3 nights
rollover.label: assumed
rollover.source: OANDA financing costs row in docs/research/sources.md

entry.rule: long at the open of the first daily bar after the setup bar; the research rule entered at the setup close, where a live order cannot fill
entry.label: assumed

expiryDays.label: assumed
expiryDays.source: 10 trading days of the time exit as calendar days, https://github.com/mfittko/market-signals/issues/430
